programme.title: Thor: Ragnarok
programme.desc: Imprisoned on the alien planet Sakaar, Thor must escape to save his home, Asgard, from Hela, the goddess of death and prevent the prophesied Ragnarok.

programme.title: The A-Team
programme.desc: A collective of Iraq War veterans seek to clear their name with the US military after being framed for criminal activity.

programme.title: Cosmoball
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a galactic war that shattered the moon and shifted Earth's poles, a massive spaceship named 'Cosmoball' hovers ominously above the planet.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Lao Luo and his horse achieve instant worldwide fame through a recorded physical altercation against creditors. This veteran performer and his equine companion gain immense popularity after the intense encounter becomes a trend.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian
programme.desc: Peter, Susan, Edmund and Lucy join Prince Caspian to reclaim Narnia from Miraz's oppressive rule, bring back its lost harmony and rightful heir.

programme.title: Zombieland
programme.desc: Columbus, a college student, joins forces with three eccentric strangers to survive a zombie apocalypse and travel through the south-western USA to a safe haven.

programme.title: Doctor Strange
programme.desc: In an accident, Stephen Strange, a famous neurosurgeon, loses the ability to use his hands. He goes to visit the mysterious Ancient One to heal himself and becomes a great sorcerer under her tutelage.

programme.title: Free Guy
programme.desc: Guy lives a seemingly peaceful life as a bank teller. However, an encounter with a pretty but mysterious woman makes him realise that he is a non-playable character in a massive online video game.

programme.title: Kingsman: The Secret Service
programme.desc: Eggsy, a promising but unemployed young man, finds himself being recruited into a secret spy organisation to hunt down an eco-terrorist.

programme.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
programme.desc: As Steve Rogers tries to adapt to the modern world, he forges new alliances and faces a threat that turns out to be an old friend.

programme.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
programme.desc: Shang-Chi, a martial artist, lives a quiet life after he leaves his father and the shadowy Ten Rings organisation behind. Years later, he is forced to confront his past when the Ten Rings attack him.

programme.title: Jumanji
programme.desc: Two siblings find an eerie board game after moving into their new house. While playing it, they release a man, who has been trapped in it for 26 years, and dangers from the jungle.

programme.title: Elysium
programme.desc: In 2154, where the rich reside in an advanced space station and the rest of the people thrive in poverty on Earth, a former criminal sets off on a mission to reinstate equality.

programme.title: Eragon
programme.desc: Farm boy Eragon discovers a dragon's egg and bonds with the hatchling. As he learns to ride it, he realises his destiny as a dragon rider who must overthrow an evil king.

programme.title: Journey to the West: Conquering the Demons
programme.desc: Tang Sanzang, a Buddhist, decides to free a fishing village of demons it is plagued by. He teams up with Miss Duan, a demon hunter, and begins to fall in love with her.

programme.title: Seven Swords
programme.desc: Terror of a snake demon reigns in Changshou City as the residents battle lethal attacks. So, the Descendants of the Seven Swords must defeat the malefic creature and restore peace.
